build_momentum_encoder: build a momentum encoder network that tracks the main model parameters in SwAV training
update_momentum_parameters: update momentum encoder parameters as weighted average of main model and previous momentum state
forward_momentum_network: forward pass momentum encoder on single resolution crops for SwAV assignment
normalize_swav_prototypes: L2 normalize SwAV prototype weights for both main model and momentum encoder heads
configure_momentum_hook: configure SwAV momentum hook with momentum factor, eval mode iteration start, and crop indices
